name: Supporting Partner
summary: An entry point for anyone who wants to support Northumbria students' journey.
benefits: Name on the car alongside other Supporting Partners
Invitation to partner events held at the university
foot: Not cash? Giving us something we need counts just the same.

name: Community Partner
summary: The right entry point for local businesses and organisations who want to support Northumbria students doing something ambitious.
benefits: Logo on the car and link on the NUFS website throughout the season
Named in the season launch and end-of-year social posts
Visual presence at Formula Student UK, Silverstone 2027
foot: For organisations who want to back a local team from the beginning.

name: Team Partner
summary: A closer partnership with greater visibility and direct connection to the team and its work.
benefits: Active social media collaboration, your organisation featured in our content
Logo placement on a specific area of the car
Logo on sponsor backdrop and behind-the-scenes content
foot: For organisations who want their name on the car and a real presence in our story.

name: Innovation Partner
summary: A hands-on partnership for organisations who want to be visible, engaged, and connected to the students building the car.
benefits: Dedicated sponsor spotlight content, your story told to our audience
Increased logo placement on the car
Opportunities to engage directly with students through mentoring, recruitment and discussions
foot: For organisations that see the value in connecting with the next generation of engineers and professionals.

name: Founding Partner
summary: Our flagship partnership, designed for an organisation that wants to play a genuine role in shaping NUFS from the very beginning.
benefits: Prioritised and prominent logo placement across all team assets, car, kit and materials
First right of renewal for future seasons
Bespoke student engagement, mentoring, placements, site visits and graduate recruitment
Input into how your partnership is structured and developed over time
Recognition as a Founding Partner of NUFS, the team that started it all
foot: Founding Partner is not a fixed package. It is a conversation.
